key_insight: An Ishikawa 6M framework links five major welding discontinuities to interconnected process factors and preventive controls.
engineering_relevance: The framework can guide welding quality management to support structural integrity, equipment reliability, and component safety.
method: Qualitative, exploratory literature review and documentary analysis.
Review of welding quality standards, particularly ABNT NBR ISO 3834.
Ishikawa classification across Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment.
evidence_signal: The review identified porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut, but the abstract reports no empirical validation or quantitative performance evaluation.
watch_item: Validate the proposed cause–control relationships in production before assuming reductions in welding discontinuities.
paper_title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH
